That cap is fixed by this build and the way material is split is fixed too, so distilling the same note again stops in the same place — split this material into shorter notes and distill those instead.

checkup.confirmWithSemantic: One local-model judgement per claim, then a sweep for near-duplicate pages. You can cancel any time — whatever was judged is kept.
checkup.confirmNoSemantic: One local-model judgement per claim. Near-duplicate detection will be skipped — the semantic index is not ready. You can cancel any time — whatever was judged is kept.
checkup.cleanHint: Orphans, broken links, empty notes and backlog are all clear. A deep checkup also rereads every topic-page claim against its source.
checkup.truncated: {{count}} more findings of the same kinds are folded away; they show up once these are handled.
checkup.dashboardLine: {{count}} things in your vault could use a tidy-up

contradiction.title: This claim conflicts with the source it cites
contradiction.desc: The local model read the source note and thinks the claim contradicts it. It is a prompt to look, not a verdict.
contradiction.todo: What to do: open the page and check it against the source — rewrite the line if the source changed its mind, delete it if the line was wrong. Lunarca will not decide which is right.

outdated.title: The source moved on — this claim looks stale
outdated.desc: The local model thinks the source note has since changed while this line still reflects the old state.
outdated.todo: What to do: open the page and update the line to what the source says now; press ✕ if it still holds. You can also run “File into a topic page…” on the source again and let Lunarca write a fresh one.

stale-citation.title: The cited source changed after this was written
stale-citation.desc: The source note was edited after this claim landed on the topic page — worth a second look.
stale-citation.todo: What to do: open the page and glance at the claim — press ✕ if it still holds, fix it if it does not. This one only tells you the source moved, not that the claim is wrong.

near-duplicate.title: Two pages say nearly the same thing
near-duplicate.desc: These two cover the same ground. Keeping both means every future filing has to pick one.
near-duplicate.todo: What to do: open both pages, keep one, fold the other into it and delete it — merging gets more expensive the longer you wait.

broken-link.title: A link points to a note that does not exist
broken-link.desc: “{{subject}}” has no note yet and is referenced from {{count}} places.
broken-link.desc_one: “{{subject}}” has no note yet and is referenced from {{count}} place.
broken-link.todo: What to do: open the citing page and pick one — point the link at the right note, or create a note under that name.

unreadable-folder.title: A folder can’t be read
unreadable-folder.desc: Lunarca doesn’t have permission to open this folder, so the notes inside aren’t indexed — they won’t show up in search and links to them won’t resolve.
unreadable-folder.todo: What to do: give this folder read access in Finder (Get Info › Sharing & Permissions), then reopen the vault or rebuild the index in Settings. This will go away.

untagged.title: Some notes have no tags yet
untagged.desc: {{count}} knowledge notes have no AI relation tags. Topic-page suggestions need tags to form a cluster (3+ notes sharing one tag), so until these are tagged there will be no suggestions.
untagged.todo: What to do: run a vault-wide pass on the right (a few minutes, cancellable). That card also lists the folders you disabled, so you can re-enable them there.

orphan.title: Nothing connects to this note
orphan.desc: No links, no tags — so it never shows up in the graph, the tag tree or any topic page.
orphan.todo: What to do: use “File into a topic page…” to connect it (you get a diff preview first), or add a tag so it joins a cluster.

empty-note.title: This page is empty
empty-note.desc: A file with no body. Usually created and never written, or emptied out.
empty-note.todo: What to do: open it and either write it or delete it. Empty pages keep showing up in search and the tree.

distill-backlog.title: Material has not been distilled yet
distill-backlog.desc: {{count}} recordings/transcripts/chats are still raw material. Distilling them is what puts them into the knowledge network.
distill-backlog.todo: What to do: open the batch dialog on the right, pick a template and let the queue run; single notes can also be distilled from the tree's context menu.

settle-backlog.title: Unsorted items are piling up
settle-backlog.desc: {{count}} items still need sorting, and the oldest hasn't been touched in over two weeks. Unsorted items stay out of the graph, are never auto-tagged, and yield to proper notes in vault Q&A.
settle-backlog.todo: What to do: open them from the button on the right — the “Unsorted” badge in the header turns one into a note in a single click; to have the AI write one up first, use “Write a knowledge note” next to it. Which ones are ready is your call, not Lunarca's.

checkup.deepNotReady: Nothing to deep-check right now: there are no topic-page claims with sources yet, and the semantic index isn't ready. Once topic pages grow — or you enable semantic search and build the index — the deep checkup shows up here.

contribution.link_import: “Import from link” in Transcribe, and “Video link” in Create’s Add sources
contribution.settings: Download format and download proxy under Settings › Recording & transcription

permission.network: Network: only when you paste a link and start a download, or click install / check for updates; never in strict local mode
permission.external_programs: Open-source tools: installing downloads the open-source download tools it needs from their official releases and verifies them on this computer; anything already on this computer is used as is
permission.vault_folder: Files: transcripts go to your transcripts folder, or to the project’s Materials folder when added from Create

link_import.legal: Only import content you own or are authorized to use, and follow the source platform’s terms of service. Lunarca does not read your browser sign-ins and does not bypass sign-in, paywalls or DRM; you are responsible for what you download and how you use it.

paste.title: Paste a link to import
paste.body: Public videos from thousands of sites, including YouTube and Bilibili.

local.title: Transcribed on this computer
local.body: Downloads become timestamped transcripts right here.

sources.title: Straight into your projects
sources.body: With Create installed, a video link can be a project source.

components.title: Open-source components and licenses
components.hint: Components are third-party programs this app needs. Downloads, updates and removal only happen when you click.
components.installFirst: Once “{{name}}” is installed, you can update or remove each component here.

install.title: Install “{{name}}”?
install.limited: Installed, but a component didn't install, so some sites may not work. You can add it from the components below.
install.downloads: Download about {{size}} of open-source components from their official releases and verify them on this computer
install.usesExisting: Use components already on this computer instead of downloading them again
install.note: You can uninstall it from Apps at any time. Uninstalling never deletes anything in your vault.

update.failed: Couldn't update. The previous version is still in place. Try again later.

updates.hint: App components, themes and templates never update automatically. Click Check for updates when you want to.
updates.upToDateWithDisabled: Nothing to update. Disabled: {{disabled}} (see the Installed tab for why).
updates.availableWithDisabled: Updates available: {{count}}. Disabled: {{disabled}} (see the Installed tab for why).
updates.failed: Couldn't check for updates. Try again later.
updates.strictLocal: Strict local mode keeps Lunarca offline, so it can't check for updates.
updates.trustChanged: The server's identity has changed since last time, so its content wasn't used. Check the connected server in Settings › Account.

themes.lede: Themes change colors only, not layout. Light and dark still follow Appearance mode in Settings.
themes.localMetaUpdate: Installed locally · {{author}} · {{license}} · Version {{version}}, update to {{to}} available
themes.previewing: Previewing “{{name}}”. Nothing is saved; leaving this page switches back.
themes.rejected: The theme package failed the format or contrast check. Your current theme is unchanged.
themes.alreadyInstalled: The same or a newer version of this theme is already installed, so nothing was replaced.
themes.failed: Couldn't install the theme package. Your current theme is unchanged.
themes.saveFailed: Couldn't save that change. Try again.

uninstall.title: Uninstall the theme “{{name}}”?
uninstall.description: Only this theme package is removed from Lunarca. Nothing in your vault changes.
uninstall.descriptionInUse: You're using it, so Lunarca switches back to the Lunarca theme first. Only this theme package is removed; nothing in your vault changes.

themes.formatHint: Accepts Lunarca theme packages (TOML with two color palettes). No CSS, scripts or remote resources are run.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.lede: The server banned these themes for safety reasons, so Lunarca turned them off on this device and switched back to the Lunarca theme where they were in use. Nothing was deleted; they come back automatically if the ban is lifted.

market.title: Get more themes
market.lede: Reviewed, signed themes from the server you're signed in to. Once installed they work like the themes above — preview, use, uninstall — and keep working offline.
market.unavailable: Online themes aren't available right now — you may have signed out, turned on strict local mode, or the server removed this theme. Installed themes aren't affected.

templates.lede: Starting points for writing. Using one creates a new note; the template itself never changes.
templates.createFailed: Couldn't create the note. Try again.
templates.openFolderFailed: Couldn't open the templates folder. Try again.

mine.title: Your templates · Markdown in your vault
mine.empty: No templates of your own yet. Put any .md file in the templates folder and it shows up here and in New note.

distill.title: AI distill templates
distill.empty: No distill templates of your own yet. Distilling uses the built-in structure, or you can create one here.

market.title: Get more templates
market.contentOnly: Templates only — no AI, nothing created or exported
market.installed: Got “{{name}}” (version {{version}}). Its templates now appear in their lists.
market.mismatch: The downloaded pack doesn't match the catalog, so it wasn't installed.
market.downloadFailed: Couldn't download this template pack. Try again later.
market.needsUpdate: This template pack needs a newer version of Lunarca.
market.strictLocal: Strict local mode keeps Lunarca offline, so online templates can't be fetched or checked.
market.failed: The template pack wasn't installed. Try again.

packs.title: Template packs

copy.done: Copied as "{{name}}". This copy belongs to your vault and syncs with it; uninstalling or disabling the pack does not affect it.
copy.presetsFull: Your AI presets are full. Delete a few, then copy again.
copy.distillFull: Your distill templates are full. Delete a few, then copy again.
copy.noVault: Open a vault first to copy into it.
copy.failed: Could not copy to your vault. Nothing in your vault changed.

kind.note_template: Note template (copied into your templates folder)

packs.disabled: Disabled: {{reason}}. Its templates, presets and recipes are hidden everywhere. Nothing was deleted, and it comes back on its own if the ban is lifted; copies you made in your vault are not affected.
packs.unreviewed: This template pack has not been reviewed by Lunarca. Only import packs from sources you trust.
packs.updating: This updates it from version {{from}} to {{to}}.
packs.canNothing: It doesn’t use AI and doesn’t create or export anything.

can.usesAi: Use AI (with the compute you chose in AI Services)
can.createsNotesIn: Create notes under {{dir}}/ in your vault

packs.recipesLater: Workflows in a pack imported from a file are only listed and never run. Only packs installed from "Get more templates" can run workflows.
packs.installed: Imported “{{name}}”. Its templates now appear in their lists.
packs.rejected: This file isn’t a usable template pack, or something in it didn’t pass the checks. Nothing was installed.
packs.incompatible: This template pack needs a newer version of Lunarca. Nothing was installed.
packs.alreadyInstalled: The same or a newer version of this template pack is already installed. Nothing was overwritten.
packs.changed: The file changed while you were confirming, so it wasn’t imported. Please choose it again.
packs.failed: The template pack couldn’t be installed. Please try again.

uninstall.title: Uninstall the template pack “{{name}}”?
uninstall.description: Its templates, presets and distill templates disappear from their lists. Notes you created with it and the rest of your vault are not affected.

packs.recipesRunnable: Workflows: {{titles}} — run them from “Run workflow” in a note’s or recording’s right-click menu

uninstall.title: Uninstall “{{name}}”?
uninstall.description: All of its entries are removed. Everything in your vault stays exactly as it is and remains visible in Notes, Search and Knowledge.
uninstall.descriptionWithComponents: All of its entries are removed, and the components Lunarca downloaded (about {{size}}) are deleted. Programs you installed yourself aren't touched. Everything in your vault stays as it is.

recipes.from: From the template pack "{{pack}}" {{version}}, reviewed and signed by the server.
recipes.note: It does only these steps: it downloads nothing else, runs no commands and changes no other notes. Any note it creates is an ordinary note you can simply delete.

step.llm: Process it with AI using the pack's prompt "{{prompt}}"
step.createNote: Create a new note in {{dir}}/ in your vault (never overwriting one)
step.export: Export a {{format}} file (you choose where to save it)

error.noTranscript: This recording has no transcript yet. Run it again once transcription is done.
error.wrongInput: This workflow starts from a recording, and this note has none.
error.empty: This note is empty, so there is nothing to process.
error.tooLong: The content is longer than this step can handle at once. Nothing was cut and nothing was created.
error.confirmAgain: This template pack was just updated and what it does has changed. Run it again and confirm once more.
error.gone: This workflow can no longer run (its template pack was uninstalled or disabled).
error.export: This step's export format can't be used: subtitle formats need a transcript that hasn't been translated or rewritten.
error.failed: The workflow did not finish. Any note it already created is kept; you can delete it.
